name: Model book
notes: Trades from 2021 (~5 years). A 100% SPY book used to demonstrate official strategy linkage: the core baseline, a volatility-aware risk-parity sleeve and a defensive sleeve feed this portfolio.
objective: Demonstrate how multiple official sleeves feed a single portfolio.
constraints: 100% SPY strategic allocation; no rebalance; linkage panel shows the latest run of each sleeve.
